findings_and_conditions.finding: A shared algorithm does not imply a shared image lifecycle or clipping order. Erase predicates read the current canvas, seed inside allow, grow across forbidden gaps, then clip again. Footprints read immutable original crop, run topology, embed, clip/exclude, and only later participate in global union/subtract/add and native intersection.
findings_and_conditions.direction: Keep those decisions at the existing callers. Freeze prefix-mutation, excluded-gap crossing, outside-crop donors and post-topology clip witnesses. A helper that always clips each iteration, always uses original, or always applies global allow before selection changes behavior.

findings_and_conditions.finding: Source evaluates original core for both filled-core union and later dilation restriction. Filling a cached core in place and then dilating that modified core expands permissions. findings_and_conditions.direction: Keep core immutable or use independent derived masks. Freeze raw masks for fill='core', subsequent original-core restriction, and empty core. Shared topology's input mutation/ownership contract must be explicit; numerical purity must not hide slice aliasing.
